visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two oblong breads with dark brown, charred crusts are cooking in a black frying pan on a modern induction cooktop. A pair of hands with fair skin uses professional kitchen scissors to cut a golden-brown bread resting on a silver wire rack, revealing a steaming, soft, white, and stretchy interior texture against a clean marble background. (2) A hand firmly presses two fingers into a translucent plastic container filled with pale, well-fermented dough, leaving two deep indentations that slowly spring back. Subsequently, white flour and a piece of dense, off-white starter dough are poured into the metal bucket of an MBG-036s automatic bread machine sitting on a digital scale. (3) The bread machine's internal paddle rotates to mix the flour and starter into a cohesive mass. A hand presses a finger into the risen, smooth dough inside the machine to check its elasticity. The dough is then transferred to a marble countertop, divided with a brown scraper, and expertly rolled into uniform round balls. (4) A rolling pin is used to flatten the dough into a rectangular sheet. The hands fold the dough inward to increase its thickness before spooning a generous amount of freshly chopped green onions from a glass measuring cup onto the surface. The dough is then rolled up tightly into a cylindrical log shape. (5) The shaped dough rolls are placed individually on small squares of white parchment paper and arranged on a black baking tray. White sesame seeds are sprinkled on top. The tray is inserted into a Sharp Healsio steam oven for a thirty-minute second fermentation period, under bright internal oven lighting. (6) The proofed dough is carefully placed back into the black pan. A hand turns the knob of a gas stove to ignite a small blue flame. Using metal tongs and a spatula, the chef turns the bread pieces frequently to dry-fry and sear all four sides until they reach a deep golden brown color. (7) A small amount of clear water is poured from a white pitcher into the hot pan, creating a cloud of white steam. The chef quickly covers the pan with a transparent glass lid with a black handle to trap the heat and moisture, allowing the bread to cook through completely in the steam. (8) The lid is removed to show the finished, plump breads. They are moved to a wire rack where a finger taps the hard, crispy charred surface, producing a hollow sound. Finally, the bread is torn open by hand, showcasing the fluffy, layered internal structure as variety-show style text overlays appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody with a bright piano accompaniment begins immediately. A female narrator speaks in Traditional Chinese with a warm, friendly, and high-pitched tone, introducing the old-dough pan-fried bread recipe. The background music maintains a steady 120 BPM rhythm with light percussion. (2) The rhythmic whirring and mechanical thumping of a bread machine mixing dough are clearly audible over the BGM. This is followed by a sharp, metallic click as the machine's lid is closed. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and encouraging, with very few pauses as she explains the ingredient mixing process. (3) The sound of a plastic scraper hitting a marble countertop produces several short, percussive thuds. The narrator continues her instruction with high vocal arousal and positive valence. A subtle pop sound effect marks the transition between shots as she describes dividing and rolling the fermented dough balls. (4) A distinct metallic scraping sound occurs as green onions are scooped from a glass container, followed by the soft, rhythmic rustling of dough being handled and rolled. The acoustic guitar BGM remains constant in the background, providing a light, domestic atmosphere without any noticeable audio distortion or technical glitches. (5) A dull, heavy thud is heard as the oven door is closed, followed by the mechanical sound of a timer or latch. The female voice maintains a professional yet enthusiastic tone, emphasizing the proofing time. The ambient noise is minimal, consisting only of a very faint indoor room tone. (6) A series of rapid clicks from a gas stove igniter is followed by the "whoosh" of a flame catching. A light, consistent sizzling sound begins as the dough pieces make contact with the hot pan. The narrator's pitch variability increases as she emphasizes the importance of controlling the heat. (7) A sudden, loud splashing and intense sizzling sound erupts as water is poured into the hot pan, followed by the resonant clatter of a glass lid being placed on top. The narrator's voice remains clear above this noise, though the music volume ducks slightly to accommodate the sound of the steam. (8) The sizzling subsides into a soft simmer. As the lid is removed, a finger taps the bread crust, creating a series of crisp, high-frequency percussive sounds. The video concludes with the narrator's enthusiastic final recommendation and a final upbeat musical flourish, accompanied by comic-style 'ding' sound effects.
